files.fileContent:
import Foundation
import SwiftData

@Model
final class PlantEntity {
    @Attribute(.unique) var id: UUID = UUID()
    var commonName: String = ""
    var scientificName: String = ""
    var family: String = ""
    var plantDescription: String = ""
    var careInstructionsData: Data?
    @Attribute(.externalStorage) var imageData: Data?
    var identifiedAt: Date = Date.now
    var confidence: Double = 0

    // Garden fields (V2)
    var nickname: String?
    var isInGarden: Bool = false
    var addedToGardenAt: Date?
    var gardenDetailsData: Data?

    init(
        id: UUID = UUID(),
        commonName: String,
        scientificName: String,
        family: String,
        plantDescription: String,
        careInstructionsData: Data? = nil,
        imageData: Data? = nil,
        identifiedAt: Date = .now,
        confidence: Double = 0,
        nickname: String? = nil,
        isInGarden: Bool = false,
        addedToGardenAt: Date? = nil,
        gardenDetailsData: Data? = nil
    ) {
        self.id = id
        self.commonName = commonName
        self.scientificName = scientificName
        self.family = family
        self.plantDescription = plantDescription
        self.careInstructionsData = careInstructionsData
        self.imageData = imageData
        self.identifiedAt = identifiedAt
        self.confidence = confidence
        self.nickname = nickname
        self.isInGarden = isInGarden
        self.addedToGardenAt = addedToGardenAt
        self.gardenDetailsData = gardenDetailsData
    }

    convenience init(dto: PlantDTO) {
        self.init(
            id: dto.id,
            commonName: dto.commonName,
            scientificName: dto.scientificName,
            family: dto.family,
            plantDescription: dto.plantDescription,
            careInstructionsData: dto.careInstructionsData,
            imageData: dto.imageData,
            identifiedAt: dto.identifiedAt,
            confidence: dto.confidence,
            nickname: dto.nickname,
            isInGarden: dto.isInGarden,
            addedToGardenAt: dto.addedToGardenAt,
            gardenDetailsData: dto.gardenDetailsData
        )
    }
}

// MARK: - DTOConvertible

extension PlantEntity: DTOConvertible {

    func toDTO() -> PlantDTO {
        PlantDTO(
            id: id,
            commonName: commonName,
            scientificName: scientificName,
            family: family,
            plantDescription: plantDescription,
            careInstructionsData: careInstructionsData,
            imageData: imageData,
            identifiedAt: identifiedAt,
            confidence: confidence,
            nickname: nickname,
            isInGarden: isInGarden,
            addedToGardenAt: addedToGardenAt,
            gardenDetailsData: gardenDetailsData
        )
    }
}

+import Foundation
+import SwiftData
+
+// MARK: - V1: Original schema (PlantEntity only)
+
+enum PlantScannerSchemaV1: VersionedSchema {
+
+    static var versionIdentifier: Schema.Version { .init(1, 0, 0) }
+
+    static var models: [any PersistentModel.Type] {
+        [PlantEntity.self]
+    }
+
+    @Model
+    final class PlantEntity {
+        @Attribute(.unique) var id: UUID
+        var commonName: String
+        var scientificName: String
+        var family: String
+        var plantDescription: String
+        var careInstructionsData: Data?
+        @Attribute(.externalStorage) var imageData: Data?
+        var identifiedAt: Date
+        var confidence: Double
+
+        init(
+            id: UUID = UUID(),
+            commonName: String,
+            scientificName: String,
+            family: String,
+            plantDescription: String,
+            careInstructionsData: Data? = nil,
+            imageData: Data? = nil,
+            identifiedAt: Date = .now,
+            confidence: Double = 0
+        ) {
+            self.id = id
+            self.commonName = commonName
+            self.scientificName = scientificName
+            self.family = family
+            self.plantDescription = plantDescription
+            self.careInstructionsData = careInstructionsData
+            self.imageData = imageData
+            self.identifiedAt = identifiedAt
+            self.confidence = confidence
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// MARK: - V2: Garden + Care tracking
+
+enum PlantScannerSchemaV2: VersionedSchema {
+
+    static var versionIdentifier: Schema.Version { .init(2, 0, 0) }
+
+    static var models: [any PersistentModel.Type] {
+        [
+            PlantEntity.self,
+            CareTaskEntity.self,
+            CareLogEntity.self,
+            CareNoteEntity.self
+        ]
+    }
+}
